coordinate_scope: Each attached two-point PDB contains donor then acceptor centroid coordinates in angstrom, in that topology order. Carbon symbols are placeholders for distance software, not claims of carbon-atom positions or molecular masses. The two states are the complete allowed structural mixture model.
model: For each static state,transfer efficiency is E(r)=1/(1+(r/R0)^6). States do not interconvert during one donor excited-state lifetime;ensemble absorption and donor excitation/detection weighting are equal across states. Thus measured normalized efficiency is the population-weighted mean of the two state efficiencies. R0and backgrounds are independently calibrated;no orientation-factor or brightness uncertainty is included.
target: Recover the actual two centroid distances from the attachments and infer the near-state population fraction. Report the population mean distance and the single-distance surrogate obtained by inverting the ensemble efficiency through the same E(r)law. Assess whether the surrogate establishes that every molecule is at one intermediate distance. Use angstrom for all distances.

provenance.kind: Controlled abstract biological inference fixture;not empirical mechanism or intervention evidence.
